subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.-----C.CONT.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(CW)-31. The prose above identifies the structural target about the reality implications of bebop transcending regionalism. The crossing diagrams how multi-information structurally meets composite-continuance: MT-INFO crossed with C-CONT. MT-INFO sits at left with the subject-arrow; C-CONT at center-bottom as partner-axis. EXT-DY (extended dynamics) upper-center, POL-CONT (political continuance) upper-right. POST (postulation) left. POL-P (political policies), TR (transformation), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) center-to-right. AFI (affinity insight) drops from the main line and carries APT-DY, from which POST rises; POL-P hangs from the POL-CONT line; TRS (transition) hangs from the PROG-CONT line, which branches from TR, and carries (R)INTR (reality of interpretation).
